```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```




```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = read_html(url)

drug_use_html
```


pull the tables out

```{r}

marj_df =
  drug_use_html |>
  html_table() |>
  first() |>  #first table
  slice(-1)  #delete the first row
```



import starwars data

```{r}
swm_html =
```

